title: Backward scan action
statement: For a register $r$, states $s_0,n_x$, and an optional Boolean symbol $c$, define the action to be $xAct(r,0,-1,s_0)$ when $c$ is present, and $xAct(r,0,1,n_x)$ when $c$ is absent.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define xAct, so the underlying action cannot be described beyond its arguments.
